scope: Official Shopify Enterprise:Outlet preset listing View demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility tree. Home, 819-item Shop All collection, 514g Eco Gold Chalk Honnold Edition PDP and empty cart inspected. No shopper actions, screenshot, viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Enterprise:Outlet listing View demo opened enterprise-theme-active.myshopify.com.

claims.observed: Adventure home links activity stories to deep product departments; 819-product collection has filter/sort and grid/list affordances plus compare, variant and promotion markers.
claims.risk: No collection controls were tested; stock, price, promotion and ratings are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Use activity taxonomy and product attributes to support broad catalogs; validate any comparison and availability signals.

claims.observed: Chalk PDP separates description, specifications and reviews, provides quantity and Add to Cart, and recommends complementary products. Empty cart offers Start Shopping and a product carousel.
claims.risk: No quantity/cart action tested; product specs, supplier, athlete, rating and related-product content are seller-provided.
claims.vsn_guard: Surface technical specs and substantiated reviews, and recommend compatible gear while preserving a clear empty-cart recovery route.
